jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(1)(B) inventory: Fairfax School District, a town school district in the Franklin West Supervisory Union (member town: Fairfax). The district operates Bellows Free Academy Fairfax; the separately-elected BFA Trustees are a distinct incorporated-school body and are NOT modeled here.
Bellows Free Academy Fairfax (official school site).

sources.note: Fairfax School Board page (official): five directors -- Emily Aiken (Chair), MacKenzie Geary (Clerk), Katie Haddock, Ed Nasta, Danielle Rothy. The board is five directors at-large (16 V.S.A. section 423(a)-(b): three 3-year seats, two 2-year seats). Aiken was re-elected March 3, 2026 to the 2-year seat (sole printed candidate; the board's March 9, 2026 summary confirms); Geary holds a 3-year term to 2028 (March 10, 2025 reorganization summary); Haddock's term runs to 2027 (Town Report 2025 officers list).

Fairfax board meeting summaries (official): the March 9, 2026 summary records two open seats after the March 3, 2026 election (the 3-year race and the 1-year-remainder race were write-in only and seated no winner) and that 'Two new members will be appointed at the April meeting.' Ed Nasta and Danielle Rothy are the two members added to the board page after that date and are recorded APPOINTED. The April 2026 meeting minutes naming them and assigning the seats (one holds the 3-year seat to 2029, the other the 1-year remainder to 2027) were not posted -- the assignment is UNRESOLVED and no term is asserted for either.

The Fairfax board's March 9, 2026 summary records: 'Matthew Hogan has stepped down from the board after six years of dedicated service.' His term expired in 2026 (Town Report 2025) and his 3-year seat was left open by the March 3, 2026 election. Ended 2026.

Fairfax board summary, December 8, 2025: the board 'voted unanimously (3-0) to appoint Scott Mitchell to serve the remainder of the term through Town Meeting Day on March 3, 2026' (the Frechette vacancy). He signed the February 2, 2026 warning as a director and does not appear on the post-election board. Ended 2026.

Fairfax board summaries, October 14 and November 11, 2025: Jolie Frechette (elected March 2025 to a 2-year term) resigned in fall 2025 on relocating to another town; the vacancy was filled by appointment until the March election. Ended 2025.
